description: This file contains SQL statements to set up 'tasks' and 'bugs' tables in a database, along with policies for row-level security and necessary extensions. It is used to initialize database schema and permissions for these entities in a project related to task and bug tracking.
calls: create extension if not exists pgcrypto
create table if not exists public.tasks
create table if not exists public.bugs
alter table public.tasks enable row level security
alter table public.bugs enable row level security
create policy "Allow select for all (dev)" on public.tasks
create policy "Allow insert for all (dev)" on public.tasks
create policy "Allow select for all (dev)" on public.bugs
create policy "Allow insert for all (dev)" on public.bugs
